description: Render a static PNG map from a center and zoom or bounding box. Supports GeoJSON overlays, result handles, and up to 50 labeled markers. Dark and light styles use raster rendering; other preset or profile names use vector rendering. Requires a subscription key.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north]. Fits the viewport to this instead of using lat/lon/zoom.

geojson.description: GeoJSON to draw, or a result handle such as rh_ followed by 32 hex characters.

style.description: dark or light composites the raster basemaps. Any other value names a style preset or one of your saved basemap profiles and is rendered as vector against that compiled style.

styleRevision.description: Saved profile revision to use for rendering.

name: geo_render
